post.description:
Exposes the **Streamline MCP Server** over HTTP. Requires authentication (**`X-API-Key`** or **OAuth Bearer**). This endpoint is the single entrypoint for MCP-compatible clients (e.g. Cursor, Claude Desktop) to:

- Discover available MCP tools.
- Invoke tools such as: **search_assets**, **search_families**, **search_sets**, **find_sets_by_name**, **get_icon_by_hash**, and **download_asset**.

**download_asset** returns JSON with a short-lived signed **downloadUrl** (JWT in the query). The `tools/call` that mints the URL is authenticated. Clients **GET** that URL **without** repeating `X-API-Key` or Bearer; the signed URL authorizes the download.

**Getting an API key:** Generate or manage your key at [streamlinehq.com/profile?tab=api_keys](https://www.streamlinehq.com/profile?tab=api_keys), then send it as the `X-API-Key` header.

**Pricing:** Access via the Public API + MCP Server (up to 1,000 assets/week) is included in [Pro plans](https://home.streamlinehq.com/pricing).
